description: List the credit bundles your workspace sells: each one's id, name, code, price, billing frequency, credits (null for unlimited), rollover and status (active, inactive or archived). Early access: answers released false with no bundles until credit bundles are switched on for the workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with billing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: list_credit_bundle_plans
